label: High Distress and Loneliness
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively higher loneliness, depressive symptoms, and anxiety symptoms across the measured indicators.
demographic_anchor: Female, graduate education or above, and more than 5 hours.
behavior_markers: Reports relatively high loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure.
Shows elevated depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9.
Shows elevated anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7.
Represents a training-split subgroup of 165 respondents.

label: Low Distress, Low Loneliness
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively low loneliness, low depressive symptoms, and very low anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: Typically male, with graduate-level education or above, and reporting 1–3 hours in the referenced time-use category.
behavior_markers: Lower UCLA-8 loneliness scores than higher-distress profiles
Very low GAD-7 anxiety symptom levels
Overall pattern suggests relatively strong emotional well-being within this sample

label: Higher loneliness with lower depressive and anxiety symptoms
summary: Respondents in this profile report comparatively elevated loneliness while showing relatively low average depressive and anxiety symptoms.
demographic_anchor: More commonly anchored by female respondents with graduate-level education or above and 1-3 hours as the referenced time category.
behavior_markers: Reports higher average loneliness on the UCLA-8 measure
Shows lower average depressive symptoms on the PHQ-9
Shows lower average anxiety symptoms on the GAD-7
Demographic anchor includes graduate or higher education
tone: Socially disconnected but not broadly distressed; emotionally relatively stable despite elevated loneliness.
